items.name: Rotting Meteor
items.function: It is able to launch a dark-green projectile that could instantly poison and rot the enemy's physical and spiritual body instantly. It is effective even against a Demigod.
items.downside: The holder has the probability to be watched by certain existence in The Cosmos, and unknowingly being corrupted. The user had a certain chance of sudden death or produce an anomaly.

items.name: Concerto of Light and Shadow
items.appearance: An iron-skinned pocket watch, half of the watch's face is filled with neatly arranged symbols, while the other half is chaotic.
items.function:
1. It can restrict certain actions in the area, and strip certain Beyonder powers from the target.
2. It can also gift certain negative effects to the target, making him sluggish; eager; avaricious; or lose their fighting spirit.
3. It could distort the target's speech, actions, intentions, and attacks, reducing a lethal blow into a serious injury, or it could repel an attack, turning progression into retrogression, escaping into leading a charge.
items.downside: When the user enter combat state, random change that affects Beyonder abilities will uncontrollably occur within its range.

items.name: Antigonus Family's Notebook
items.function: Contains the legacy of the Antigonus family.
items.downside: Secretly corrupts the person who flips through its content.

items.name: Golden Sundial
items.function: Manifesting the sun, directing all the light and heat to the desired target.
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Arrodes
items.appearance: A silver mirror with ancient patterns on the back and an eye-like pattern on each side at the front.
items.function: Powerful divination capabilities.
items.downside: Forces user to answer embarrassing questions or receive a punishment. Must be used in the presence of others.

items.name: Ullamos Statue
items.appearance: A milky-white stone statue half the height of a person. It portrayed a beautiful half-naked woman, her dress torn away to the waist.
items.function: It would entice nearby creatures to obsess over it, spreading various illnesses, some common and others mystical in nature.
items.downside: It would transform its surroundings into a nightmarish landscape of agony — living beings wailing, writhing, and perishing in horrifying ways.

items.function: Unknown
items.downside: Shifting target (either physical body or mind) into a dream between reality and illusion.

items.function: Everything that is reflected will become a mirror world that only targets Beyonders.
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Berserker's Armor
items.appearance: A silver full-body armor with dark-red bloodstains.
items.function: Gives user great strength, defense and tracking ability.
items.downside: The user cannot use for too long without being infected with a sort of icy silver.

items.function: When used, it can erase the selected memories from the target.
items.downside: Can turn user and target into an amnesiac (uncontrollable).

items.appearance: A young woman wearing a nun's attire.
items.function:
* Manipulator
  * Power of "Speech".
* Heavybringer
items.downside: Sometimes enters a state of madness during which surrounding people get infected with "Derangement".

items.name: Fallen Flute
items.function:
Once the wielder blows it, the living around it will fall into an unavoidable illusion as their emotions and desires would rapidly swell.
The wielder will be extremely sensitive to danger and sometimes can even predict a threat to its life one to two days earlier.
items.downside:
Wherever this artifact is, one's humanity will gradually degenerate.
The user would become colder, the longer used the deeper it becomes.

items.name: Life's Cane
items.function: Controls spiritual creatures, mutates other creatures, create artificial golems and humans, powerful healing abilities.
items.downside: The user would have a high chance of mutation. The longer they hold the cane, the higher the chance. This will result in additional organs, or even having body parts being replaced by various plants.

items.name: Twilight Mask
items.function: Death by eye contact, powerful death attack, high resistance to everything except purifying attacks, allows user to hide intentions.
items.downside: People around it will mysteriously and suddenly die unless sealed, user assaulted with powerful mental attacks, becomes the artifact's slave if worn for too long.

items.name: Sword of Silverdawn
items.appearance: A sword with a single-eyed, huge-mouthed head engraved at the tip of its hilt.
items.function: Hides wielder's intentions, show various effect when fed with corresponding ingredients, enhances defense, creates storms of dawn light.
items.downside: Requires certain height to use, living artifact that could capriciously fail or make user lose control.

items.name: Unshadowed Crucifix
items.function:
By sacrificing some blood to it, it will exude a bright light that purifies any evil influences, it will purify beyonder characteristics too.
In addition to its purifying effects, this item also has Demigod abilities in the field of 'Sun', such as "Sun Flare."
items.downside: Cannot be worn with other Beyonder item, slowly degrading user sequence if user is not an angel, will turn the user into a pious Sun believer.

items.name: Sea God Scepter
items.appearance: A short white scepter, its tip is embedded with many tiny blue gems.
items.function: Controls weather, Sea, Sea Creatures, Lightning, Wind and enchanting items.
items.downside: Makes the user angry, drains all blood in a radius periodically, receives overwhelming prayers of believers.

items.name: Vision of White
items.function:
The user can use it by looking through it to seek for a trace of evil and contaminated beings.
It can send a pure white blazing ray of light, filled with purification power to cleanse the locked target in its sight.
items.downside: The holder would feel the heat of being exposed directly to a blazing sun, unless it is sealed properly.

items.name: General of the Pupil-less Eye
items.appearance: A palm-sized exquisitely crafted male puppet and wearing a dark red gold-encrusted dress. Only two black holes left on its eye sockets.
items.function: This item could could possess a target and control every non-living thing within a certain radius according to the holder's thought.
items.downside: It has a living characteristic. User needs to feed it with their own flesh or it would grow its eyes back gradually. Once its eyes are intact and left unsealed, it will turn into an evil spirit that hate all human beings and would chase their owner crazily.

items.name: Devil's Oil Painting
items.appearance: An oil painting painted with abstract and incomprehensible contents.
items.function: It can seal and release creatures at demigod level.
items.downside: Just looking at it would make one feel dizzy and mentally weak.

items.name: Saint Selena's Ashes
items.appearance: Shining sand in an urn box.
items.function: Darkening surroundings and producing black threads to restrain people.

items.name: Sword of Courage
items.function:
*This sword fills its bearer with courage.
*It's extremely durable and sharp, capable of blocking direct attacks from demigods and significantly impacting their defences.
*It can also enable the user to perform Cull at the level of an Iron-blooded Knight.
*If the sword is coated with the target's blood or if they've been scorched by its flames, the user can throw it up to five kilometres into the sky. It will wrap itself in flames, fly toward the target and then crash down, creating a violent explosion.
items.downside:
*Excessive courage can lead to people losing their their ability to judge and analyse, leading to a swift demise.
*The user will need to prepare at least thirty ordinary broadswords to place around it. Otherwise, it will start attacking everyone nearby indiscriminately.

items.name: Black Tear
items.function:
*It continuously produces mystical pathogens that spread it around without stopping.
*It can help its wearer master some mirror magic, including passing messages through the mirror world, Mirror Traversal, and mirror illusions.
items.downside:
*The wearer also gets infected with the mystical pathogen, with Demonesses of Affliction being less affected and more resistant.
*The wearer experiences intermittent Pleasure, every 45 to 90 seconds.
*Having Black Tear increases the likelihood of unwanted romantic encounters.

items.name: Merumu's Spellbook
items.appearance: A thin book bound in human skin, with many mysterious patterns and symbols on the cover.

items.name: Eye of Omniscience
items.appearance: A transparent, pure gemstone eye, with different brilliance flashing from each facet.

items.name: Face of the Arcane
items.appearance: A mask with only the left side.

items.name: Flog
items.function:
*It induces a surge of desire or emotion of the target. The user can predict and influence the target's reaction, with a success rate of 70-80%.
*It possesses unparalleled sturdiness, capable of withstanding an assault from a Reaper without sustaining damage.
items.downside:
*Carrying the boxing glove will have a negative impact on one's self-control.
*Wearing the boxing glove will draw the attention of a hidden entity.

items.name: Bottle of Slavery
items.appearance: A transparent glass bottle stained with a dark colour.
items.function: Able to grant wish of its holder.
items.downside: Will try to trick people into becoming its slaves.

items.name: Remains of a Deformed Person
items.function: Unknown
items.downside: Unknown
